name: Lesaka (Spain)
description: Square flag of rays of crimson, light blue, white and olive yellow radiating from the centre, within a chequered border of the same colours, charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Lesaka.
history: Municipal flag of Lesaka; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: crimson rays radiating from the centre
rays and squares of the border
olive yellow rays and squares of the border
Lesaka arms — chains, a cross and bars, with crown
